rst31-v2-r6-ops-q001.objective: Calculate customers per staff-hour while accounting for service differences.
rst31-v2-r6-ops-q001.stem: A full-service restaurant served200customers with40staff-hours on the same day. Which calculation and judgment are appropriate?
options: 5customers/staff-hour. Consider time spent on table service; a lower figure than a different service model does not alone prove inefficiency.
200customers/staff-hour. Judge by customer count without staff-hours.
5customers/staff-hour. A lower figure always means inefficiency, whatever the service model.
rst31-v2-r6-ops-q001.explanation: 200÷40＝5customers/staff-hour. Table service takes labor time, so figures from different service models cannot alone establish good or bad efficiency.
reasons: Uses customers÷staff-hours and considers time needed for service.
Without staff-hours as the denominator, this is not customers per staff-hour.
The calculation is right, but the service difference is ignored.
The numerator and denominator are reversed. Divide customers by staff-hours.

rst31-v2-r6-ops-q002.objective: Calculate cumulative sales share and apply the stated ABC practice bands.
rst31-v2-r6-ops-q002.stem: Same-period sales: X50,000yen, Y30,000yen, Z20,000yen. Sort by descending sales. For this exercise, cumulative share at row end≤70%isA,>70%to90%isB,>90%isC. What are Y’s cumulative share and category?
options: 100%, C. Use the total for every product as Y’s cumulative share.
30%, A. Use Y’s individual share as its cumulative share.
80%, B. These are exercise bands; a business may use different bands.
80%, A. The second-ranked product is A regardless of cumulative share.
rst31-v2-r6-ops-q002.explanation: Total sales are100,000yen. Through Y, cumulative sales are50,000＋30,000＝80,000yen, or80%; this is B under the exercise bands. Bands vary by business.
reasons: 100%is cumulative through Z, not through Y.
30%is Y’s individual share, not the cumulative share from X.
Adds X and Y, divides by the total and applies the stated bands.
80%exceeds the exercise’s A band. Rank alone does not set the category.
